Command: cd /workspace/project && cat -A split_lines.sh | head -20 && chmod +x split_lines.sh && ./split_lines.sh 'a,b,c'
Read-only: false
Sandbox: disabled
Exit code: 0

STDOUT:
#!/usr/bin/env bash$
# split_lines.sh: print every field of the first argument on its own line$
IFS=,$
read -r -a parts <<< "$1"$
for p in "${parts[@]}"; do$
  echo "[$p]"$
done$
[a]
[b]
[c]
